evidence.label: Chia consensus basics
evidence.claim: Chia uses Proof of Space and Time, combining farmer proofs of space with timelord proofs of time.

evidence.label: Chia consensus introduction
evidence.claim: Chia consensus uses deterministic BLS signatures controlled by farmers and verifiable delay functions for proof of time.

evidence.label: Chia proof of space
evidence.claim: Chia proof-of-space keys use BLS aggregation and its documentation distinguishes Proof of Space from Proof of Capacity.

evidence.label: Chia new proof FAQ
evidence.claim: A consensus-affecting proof-format transition is scheduled, so resource-proof agility is modeled separately from PQ consensus readiness.
